scope: Dedicated typed chat administration: compilation and controlled actual-function tests. This is not a final packaged-binary or live cross-client qualification.

checks: bounded stock chat decoding rejects malformed lengths, terminators and control characters
actual host chat hook uses transport sender and consumes proofs before any formatting or display
joined actor resolution rejects the host, unknown peers, duplicate identities and loading/disconnected slots
typed private replies use bounded ordinary DSS_CHAT only to the verified actor
roster listing is private, bounded, labels stable slots and sanitizes display-only names
exact kick selectors reject host/self/ambiguity/stale transports and use the actual QuitPlayer packet path
next-level refuses single-level sessions, pending transitions and terminal/invalid/video episode links
actual SendEndLevel broadcasts the stock packet three times and schedules the ordinary 10-second transition
every action rechecks the actor's currently joined engine identity
engine-owned nonzero incarnations are distinct and cannot be chosen by another peer
execution rejects zero/duplicate requests and wrong actor generations
a reused transport ID cannot execute an old occupant's pending authorization
map/IPC resets invalidate old bindings and session clears never reuse the serial
connection state is bounded to the host's 31 remote seats
admin_regression.instrumentation: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, halt_on_error=1. Leak scanning disabled because the container denies /proc task-list access.
admin_regression.actual_functions: Compiles sithAdmin.c, sithMulti.c and jkDSS.c. Delivery/console/roster fixtures are controlled; actual QuitPlayer and SendEndLevel serialization and timer calls execute.

checks: stock CTF first-spawn mask uses all lobby starts 16..31 at session capacity 8
red and gold stock respawn masks retain their distinct spawn ranges
configured capacity includes host, rejects eighth human, reuses only eligible freed slots
shorter maps and invalid capacity cannot allocate unavailable records
ordinary SyncPlayers serializes all 32 records without changing session capacity

contracts.identity: Host chat uses netMsg.idx from actual transport; claimed speaker/name is ignored. Execution rechecks transport membership, engine-owned nonzero generation and currently joined actor.
contracts.authority: Challenge/policy verification belongs to the authenticated local Python manager. No game packet or COG grants authority.
contracts.execution: Typed actions run atomically at a receive boundary; no console parser is exposed. Recent request IDs are bounded and deduplicated per incarnation.
contracts.kick: Exact ASCII name or #slot resolved inside engine. Ambiguous names, host, self and disconnected targets refused. Ordinary DSS_QUIT precedes native linger-close or external REMOVED; old queued external packets are purged and normal player-lost/roster sync follows.
contracts.next_level: Authored LEVEL entry only. Refuses single-level, terminal/bad/video/same-map links and pending transitions. Keeps stock DSS_ENDLEVEL broadcast and ten-second timer, existing dedicated tally auto-advance and unchanged clients normal tally.
contracts.reset: Transport reconnect, IPC loss and multiplayer map startup renew generations. ADMIN_RESET clears live manager authority. Existing INFO publishes the descriptor after normal SetSessionDesc.
contracts.proof_visibility: Dedicated host consumes admin commands before console formatting, including during loading. Peer-directed ordinary chat remains unchanged: other players can see the one-use actor-bound proof. Long-term keys must never enter chat.

remaining_validation: Live HMAC login, copied-proof/reconnect and policy lifecycle require integration checks.
These fixtures do not prove actual native, retail or browser kick delivery or authored next-level rejoin.
Integrator must rebuild/package final sources. No package manifest was changed.
